description.value: Cambie Plaza Liquor Store is a retail alcohol shop situated in the Cambie Plaza area of Richmond, BC. It offers beer, wine, and spirits for purchase with no drive-through service. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's central corridors may find it a convenient stop for resupply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to an Instagram profile, but the fetched content is entirely generic Instagram infrastructure pages (login wall, popular hashtags, legal terms) with no business-specific content visible — effectively unusable for evidence. All amenity and contact fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM provides a check_date of 2026-05-16 (very recent) and looks_closed=false, confirming the business is open; the drive_through=no tag is the only operational detail available.
concerns: The Instagram URL was discovered with only medium confidence and the fetched page content is entirely generic Instagram infrastructure — no business-specific content was accessible, so the URL cannot be confirmed as belonging to this business.
